name: chime-scheduler
description: Schedule LinkedIn posts and publish to LinkedIn from Claude. Chime Scheduler is a LinkedIn post scheduler and social media scheduler that works in the chat: write a post, say when it should go out in your own words, and the exact local time is echoed back. Plan your LinkedIn content calendar a week at a time, add images, video and a first comment, edit or cancel posts before they go out, and delete a post already live on LinkedIn (you are asked first). Built for founders, consultants and personal branding coaches. Free.
